how.title: One platform, three ways to work
how.sub: Look for a salaried role, hire for your team, or get a project done by a freelancer. Each has its own simple path.

seekers.title: Land your next role
seekers.step1: Create your profile and build a CV with the free CV Maker.
seekers.step2: Search by title, field or city and apply directly to the employer.
seekers.step3: Track every application and get new matches on Telegram.

employers.title: Hire for your team
employers.step1: Post a vacancy in minutes, in English or Amharic.
employers.step2: Review applicants and their CVs in one dashboard.

clients.title: Get a project done
clients.step1: Describe the project and set a budget.
clients.step2: Compare bids from freelancers and accept one.
clients.step3: Fund escrow and release payment milestone by milestone.

escrow.title: Money moves only when the work does.
escrow.sub: Clients fund the contract up front, so freelancers can start knowing the money is there. Each milestone is paid out only after the client approves the work.

step1.title: Fund
step1.text: The client pays the agreed amount into escrow.

step2.title: Deliver
step2.text: The freelancer submits work for each milestone.

step3.title: Approve
step3.text: The client approves the work or asks for changes.

step4.title: Get paid
step4.text: Funds reach the freelancer’s wallet after a 3-day hold.

escrow.termsSub: Everything you pay and every safeguard you get.

fee.v: 10% of each milestone, taken from the freelancer’s payout

client.v: The agreed contract amount, nothing more

timing.v: After client approval, plus a 3-day hold

disputes.v: Either side can open one. Escrow is frozen until Beleqet reviews the case.
